description: Establish the baseline: confirm the current build compiles and capture the exact set of forge-lint warnings so subsequent features can be validated against a known starting point of 93 warnings.
steps: From the Foundry root (/home/ubuntu/project/retropick/retropick-protocol/contracts), run `forge build --force` and confirm it compiles successfully (exit 0, warnings only, no errors).
Run `forge build --force 2>&1 | grep -cE '^warning\['` and confirm the count is 93.
Run `forge build --force 2>&1 | grep -E '^warning\[' | sed -E 's/:.*//' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn` to record the per-category breakdown.
Run `forge test 2>&1 | tail -30` to confirm the existing test suite baseline (record pass/fail counts). This is the regression reference for later features.
Read .agents/tasks/task-resolve-forge-lint-warnings/warnings_inventory.txt which lists every warning as `<lint-name>  ->  file:line:col`.
Record the baseline (warning count, category breakdown, test pass/fail totals) in this feature's findings field.
acceptance_criteria: `forge build --force` exits 0 with only warnings (no compilation errors).
Warning count is confirmed as 93 across the 16 documented categories.
Baseline `forge test` result is recorded (number passing / failing) for later regression comparison.
verification: forge test completes and its pass/fail totals are recorded in findings
